meta.population: 2025 QC default-base current AI users, complete on four attitude indicators; tool baskets have separate year/question-specific denominators
meta.analysis_note: Final exploratory analysis: 25780 complete-case 2025 current AI users; four attitude indicators; K=1:4, four reference starts, three split pairs and three bootstraps per K>1 (two starts/refit), one worker/script. K=3 selected by minimum BIC among convergence/size/replication/stability-eligible fits, not a globally optimal taxonomy. Class-share intervals are unavailable (null). Rule lift intervals use 200 fixed-rule multinomial respondent-bootstrap draws, not selection-adjusted or simultaneous. Networks contain singleton rules only; higher-order rules remain separate.
meta.uncertainty: Class-share intervals unavailable (null). Three bootstrap refits diagnose partition stability, not confidence intervals. Rule lift intervals: 200 multinomial respondent-bootstrap draws per rule; conditional on fixed rules, not simultaneous or selection-adjusted.
meta.class_share_definition: Model mixing proportions; n is modal-assignment count and need not equal share * n_lca.
meta.profile_definition: Model-conditional response probabilities, not observed modal-group percentages.
meta.network: At most 40 stable singleton-antecedent associations per basket, ranked by leverage; duplicated directions collapsed. Multi-item rules are separate and must not be drawn as pair edges.

baskets.description: 2023 AI search/chat + AI developer tools used (past year)
2024 AI search & developer tools used (past year)
2025 AI model families used (past year) + AI-native IDEs/agents from the dev-environment list
2025 external AI agent tools used (asked of AI-agent users only)
2026 AI coding agents/assistants + LLM providers used (past year)

limitations: Nonprobability self-selected survey; no population representativeness or causality.
Complete-case analysis may be biased by missing answers.
K search truncated at four; no claim of globally optimal or unique taxonomy.
Stability evaluated on the same full sample used for references; not held-out predictive replication.
Three split pairs and three bootstraps per K are limited diagnostics.
No cross-year latent-class replication or measurement-invariance test was completed.
Exploratory thresholds were revised after interruption; not preregistered.
Tool lists, eligibility and populations change by year; do not trend basket supports.
Mixed 2025/2026 model+IDE/agent questions condition on both being answered; this enriches co-use.
Binary have-worked-with answers do not establish simultaneous usage or workflow integration.
